name: MegaRobotics M1
summary: A 41 kg wheel-legged quadruped from the German MegaRobotics brand, built by an OEM partner, with two 3D lidars, depth camera, RTK, 30 kg walking payload and IP67. Meant for inspection of plants and substations and patrols on industrial sites outside Ex zones.

germany.statusNote: Sold by MegaRobotics (MegaForce GmbH, Kaarst) as its own brand, built by an OEM manufacturing partner; "Sourcing on request", "Inquiry only", price on request. The page says CE conformity is in preparation.

sellers.name: MegaRobotics (MegaForce GmbH)
sellers.note: "Contact for pricing"; own brand for the DACH region: "MegaRobotics supplies, integrates and services the M1 in the DACH region, built by an OEM manufacturing partner." CE conformity is in preparation.
